unit.why: A single narrative, quoted from the Komarno rebbe's Netiv Mitzvotekha: R. Yaakov Shimshon of Shepetovka in the Land of Israel sees a vision of the Shekhinah as a weeping widow and knows that R. Pinhas of Korets has died that night, which is later confirmed.

stories.start_quote: כתב מו״ר הגאוה״ק מוהרי״א מקאמרנא ז"ל
stories.end_quote: נתאמתו דברים אלו מכוון באותו לילה עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: While in the Land of Israel, R. Yaakov Shimshon of Shepetovka sees the Shekhinah as a woman mourning her husband, tells his companions that R. Pinhas of Korets has died, rends his garment, says the blessing and weeps, and the death is later confirmed to have happened that very night.
